scientific_integrity: Theorem proved from an exact simplicial cofiber sequence, integral path homotopy, signed Lefschetz reflections, and join Koszul signs; computations are corroborative, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only equal simple cycle petals of length at least four and at least two petals; homology representations for the natural full wreath symmetry, rational homology for quotients. No equivariant homotopy splitting or integral orbit-space homology asserted. Residual bibliographic risk of unindexed equivalent work.
title: Integral wreath-symmetry homology of equal-cycle bouquet independence complexes
